signal: role-level pain hypothesis: a growing software team where in-market accounts outpace rep coverage

email.body1:
Sterling, I came across Remi while mapping software teams scaling sales faster than they can hire.

That usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that gap is where deals go cold, since reps burn the day on research, writing, and CRM instead of meetings. Our AI SDR handles all of that autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Remi off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Sterling, quick follow-up for Remi.

As the team grows, the pipeline target usually outpaces what you can staff, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and by then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Remi needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Sterling, last bit of proof for Remi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Remi's reply rate likely compares to other growing startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I'll tailor it to Remi either way.
